title: Complete pending GCP technical support case
notes: Collect the last two weeks of order delivery delay evidence from New Relic and GCP. Summarize findings, draft the support case, and obtain internal review before submission.

title: Submit timesheet
notes: Review the hours for the current timesheet period, correct any missing entries and submit before the deadline.

title: Follow up with HR on promotion and career progression
notes: Follow up with HR and the relevant manager on the promotion request. Ask for the current decision, next steps and expected timeline.

title: Review Jira tickets and Confluence documentation
notes: Review assigned Jira tickets and Confluence pages. Update progress, test evidence, pending actions and any blockers.

title: Check outstanding work ticket fixes and verification
notes: Review the outstanding automated UI test fixes and device auto-lock investigation. Confirm regression coverage, ticket updates and remaining actions.

title: Check training portal access
notes: Check whether the required training account has been provisioned. Follow up with support if access is still unavailable.

title: Upload YouTube video
notes: Prepare and upload the next AI World 360 YouTube video or Short. Check title, description, tags, thumbnail, copyright and publishing settings.

title: Upload Instagram video
notes: Publish the corresponding Instagram Reel with a suitable cover, caption and hashtags. Verify playback after publishing.

title: Review YouTube and Instagram analytics
notes: Review views, retention, engagement, reach and follower or subscriber growth for recent uploads on both platforms. Note improvements for the next video.

title: Arrange car servicing
notes: Arrange a service appointment, confirm required maintenance and estimated charges, and collect the vehicle after service.

title: Prepare document photocopies, photos and lamination
notes: Prepare required identity-document photocopies, passport-size photos and lamination where appropriate. Keep originals and copies secure.

title: Print two plot-for-sale banners
notes: Prepare the plot-sale banner content and contact details, proofread both designs, obtain printing quotes and print two banners.

title: Visit temple
notes: Visit the temple and complete the planned visit.

title: Gather loan application documents
notes: Prepare the required personal loan application paperwork and check the bank's current document checklist. Keep documents private.

title: Collect salary slips and bank statements
notes: Collect the required recent salary slips and bank statements, verify that they are complete, and organize them for the loan application.

title: Confirm SBI personal loan eligibility
notes: Ask SBI to confirm personal loan eligibility, maximum sanctioned amount, interest rate, tenure, fees and required documents before applying.

title: Find three acres of land for dairy farm lease
notes: Shortlist approximately three acres of lease land in West Godavari, prioritizing the Tanuku area. Confirm whether dairy shed construction and fodder cultivation are permitted.

title: Check water, electricity, road access and rent
notes: Inspect shortlisted dairy sites for year-round water, power, vehicle access, drainage, lease rent, deposit and construction permission.

title: Enquire about milk processing and dung cake machines
notes: Obtain quotations for cream separation, ghee processing and dung cake production machines. Compare capacity, automation, power use, warranty and installation costs.

title: Identify milk and dung cake buyers
notes: Find potential daily milk buyers, tea centres and dung cake buyers in West Godavari. Confirm quantity, purchase price, collection or delivery terms and payment cycle.

title: Review Value Mela GST requirements
notes: Review GST registration requirements for Value Mela, including interstate sales and whether the planned business structure can support other activities.

title: Review Viswatra registration requirements
notes: Review registration options for the Viswatra umbrella business, GST structure, trade names and trademark requirements before committing to registration.

title: Review CareerScope progress
notes: Check CareerScope's current roadmap, verified versus partial items, open engineering blockers and CI results. Identify the next eligible item.

title: Email Factori team to follow up on price update completion
notes: Send a follow-up email to the Factori team asking whether the requested product price updates have been completed. Request confirmation and an expected completion date for any remaining changes.
